title: BUGFIX — Fix stale validPlatforms 3-platform list in Block E Analytics validation
rationale: validate-analytics-output.ts line 51 had the same stale validPlatforms = ['tiktok', 'instagram_reels', 'youtube_shorts'] as was just fixed in validate-publishing-output.ts (Sprint 1432). After Blotato multi-platform, PerformanceSignal.platform comes from BlotatoPlatform: 'instagram', 'youtube', 'tiktok', 'facebook', 'linkedin', 'threads', 'x', 'pinterest', 'bluesky'. The old 3-platform list caused the per-signal platform validation to fail for 8 of 9 platforms.

tasks.description: In scripts/scs001/validate-analytics-output.ts line 51: replace validPlatforms 3-item TikTok-era list with all 9 Blotato platform names. Added comment.
